Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

The more rituals your pack performs, the happier you are. You insist on Vaulderie at least twice a night, once at rising and once before sleep, and encourage others to participate in rituals before every anticipated combat and after every unanticipated one.
